description: This file defines the Insert class for SQLite database operations within Drupal, implementing custom insert logic including handling default values, single and multiple row inserts, and query string generation.

classes.name: Insert
classes.description: A class implementing SQLite-specific insert operations for Drupal's database abstraction layer, supporting default values and batch inserts.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the insert operation, handling single and multiple row inserts, default values, and exceptions.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Generates the SQL insert statement as a string, including handling of query components and placeholders.
